# Omniyat Corporate Office

> This workplace occupies fitted office floors in Dubai, laid out as open-plan studio space with meeting suites, a reception and client-facing presentation areas, alongside back-of-house accommodation. It houses the head-office team of a property business active in the city's luxury residential and commercial market. Offices of this kind are finished to a high specification, with lighting, acoustics and climate control tuned to long working hours and to receiving visitors.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project was an office for Omniyat, the Dubai-based developer of luxury residential and commercial properties. Working with Quebec General Contracting as the main contractor, MENASCO delivered the MEP works for the office space. The project adds a corporate workplace for one of the city's prominent property developers to MENASCO's portfolio of commercial interiors in Dubai.
